mainEntity.name: What End-of-Line Equipment Does a Protein Plant Need?

acceptedAnswer.text: A protein plant needs a top-load case packer to load packaged trays, thermoformed packages or bags into shipping cases, case conveyors with accumulation and routing, and a palletizer at the end. TRF supplies TRFRapidpack, TRFDroppack or TRFOnepack for case packing, TRFIntraflow for case conveying and a palletizer chosen by cases per minute, case weight and floor space.

mainEntity.name: Can Palletizing Equipment Operate Below Freezing for Frozen Protein?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with equipment built for it. TRFSubzero is the TRF palletizer for areas below 32°F, and frozen areas are among its target applications. TRF validates each application with your product, end-of-arm tool and pallet pattern.

mainEntity.name: How Does Automation Help With Labor Shortages in Meat and Poultry Plants?

acceptedAnswer.text: It removes the most repetitive positions at the end of the line: manual case loading and pallet building. Those operators can move to quality checks or line supervision, and output depends less on how many people are available for a given shift. Automation also reduces repeated lifting, bending and twisting.

mainEntity.name: Can One Automation Partner Supply Palletizing, Case Packing and Conveyors for a Protein Plant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRF supplies case conveying and end-of-line systems for protein plants as one integrated solution: TRFRapidpack case packing, TRFIntraflow case conveying and a TRF palletizer, with TRFSubzero for areas below 32°F. One partner is responsible from layout to startup, and Parts and Service supports TRF-supplied equipment afterward.
